questions.question: The distance between two towns is covered In 7 hours and 30 minutes at the speed of 72 km/h. The time saved if the speed is increased by 25% is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The distance between two towns is covered In 7 hours and 30 minutes at the speed of 72 km/h.

**Concept used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Total distance is, 72 × 7.5 = 540 km

New speed is , 72 + 72/4 = 90 km

The required time, 540 / 90 = 6hr

Time saved 7.5 - 6 = 1.5 hr

**∴ The correct option is 3**

questions.question: A works 5.4 times as fast as B, and A takes 22 days less than B to complete the job when each works alone. Calculate the number of days taken to complete the same job if A and B work together.
questions.solution:
Given: 

A works 5.4 times as fast as B, and A takes 22 days less than B to complete the job when each works alone. 

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Time ratio of A : B = 1 : 5.4

Time ratio of A : B = 5 : 27

So A takes 5x days B takes 27x days 

As per the question,

27x - 5x = 22

⇒ x = 1

So A takes 5 days and B takes 27 days 

So they together take,

⇒ (27 × 5) / 32 = 4(7)/(32)days

∴ The correct option is 3

questions.question: Two pipes S1 and S2 alone can fill an empty tank in 15 hours and 20 hours respectively. Pipe S3 alone can empty that completely filled tank in 40 hours. Firstly both pipes S1 and S2 are opened and after 2 hour pipe S3 is also opened. In how much time tank will be completely filled after S3 is opened?
questions.solution:
Given: 

wo pipes S1 and S2 alone can fill an empty tank in 15 hours and 20 hours respectively.

Pipe S3 alone can empty that completely filled tank in 40 hours.

Firstly both pipes S1 and S2 are opened and after 2 hour pipe S3 is also opened.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 120 units ( LCM of 15 , 20 and 40) 

The efficiency of pipe s1 is 120 /15 = 8 units

The efficiency of pipe s2 is 120 / 20 = 6 units

The efficiency of pipe S1 + S2 is 8 + 6= 14 units

In 2 hrs they will fill 14 × 2 = 28 units

Remaining amount 120 - 28 = 92 units 

The efficiency of pipe s3 is 120 / 40 = - 3 units

Now combined efficiency of all three pipes is 14 - 3 = 11 units

Time to fill remaining 92 units is

⇒ 92 / 11 hr

**∴ The correct option is 4**

questions.question: Amit can complete a piece of work in 5 hours; Jeevan and Paul together can complete It In 4 hours, while Amit and Paul together can complete It In 3 hours. Approximately, how many hours will Jeevan alone take to complete the work (rounded off to the nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Amit can complete a piece of work in 5 hours; Jeevan and Paul together can complete It In 4 hours, while Amit and Paul together can complete It In 3 hours.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 60 units ( LCM of 3,4 and 5 and 18) 

The efficiency of Amit is 60 /5 = 12 units

The efficiency of Jeevan and Paul together is 60 / 4 = 15 units

The efficiency of Amit and Paul together is 60/3 = 20 units

The efficiency of Amit is 60 /5 = 12 units

The efficiency of paul is 20 - 12= 8units

The efficiency of Jeevan is 15 - 8 = 7 units

 Jeevan alone take to complete the work 60 / 7 = 9 hr(approx)

**∴ The correct option is 3**

questions.question: The value of sec x - cos x = ?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Sec x = (1/cos x)

**Calculation:**

Sec x - cos x

⇒ (1/cos x) - cos x

⇒ (1 - cos² x)/cos x

⇒ sin² x/cos x

⇒ tan x sin x

**∴ The correct answer is tan x sin x.**
